subject: pathology
title: Alcoholic Hepatitis, Mallory-Denk Bodies, NAFLD, and NASH

steps.tx: Alcoholic hepatitis inflames a steatotic liver acutely with jaundice, fever, and tender hepatomegaly after heavy drinking, Maddrey and MELD scores grading whether steroids help or harm. That acute on chronic storm is **alcoholic hepatitis severity scoring**. This point is tested repeatedly because it changes everyday bedside decisions.
steps.say: Jaundice within weeks of heavy drinking plus high Maddrey score frames the alcoholic hepatitis steroid question.

left.title: Steroids considered
points: Lille response at day seven decides

steps.tx: Mallory-Denk bodies rope damaged intermediate filaments into eosinophilic hyaline tangles inside ballooned hepatocytes, shared by alcoholic and metabolic steatohepatitis and cholestatic injury alike. The filament tangle is the **Mallory-Denk body of steatohepatitis**. Examiners return to it because it separates careful clinicians from guesswork.
steps.say: Mallory-Denk bodies are filament wreckage in ballooned hepatocytes, not specific to alcohol alone.

vis.caption: Hepatitis biopsy patterns spanning steatohepatitis and autoimmune injury.

steps.tx: Neutrophils satelliting Mallory containing hepatocytes, chicken wire perivenular fibrosis, and steatosis compose alcoholic steatohepatitis histology before cirrhosis seals it. That triad reads **steatohepatitis histology, alcoholic pattern**. Bedside recognition of this pattern saves time, blood, and unnecessary investigation. Pathologists weigh this pattern beside clinical history because neither alone separates the causes reliably.
steps.say: Satellitosis around Mallory hepatocytes with chicken wire fibrosis is steatohepatitis under glass.

steps.tx: Non-alcoholic fatty liver disease, now metabolic dysfunction associated steatotic liver disease, fills hepatocytes with fat in obesity and diabetes, mostly indolent steatosis, minority inflaming into NASH. That spectrum is **NAFLD (MASLD) from steatosis to NASH**. Students should anchor this fact before moving to rarer causes and exceptions.
steps.say: Fat plus metabolic risk defines the modern name; only the inflamed minority march toward cirrhosis.

vis.caption: Cirrhosis endpoint shared by alcoholic and metabolic steatohepatitis roads.

steps.tx: NASH adds ballooning and lobular inflammation to steatosis with perivenular fibrosis staging its prognosis, cardiovascular disease outkilling liver disease in early stages. Fibrosis stage rules: **NASH fibrosis staging and cardiovascular priority**. In practice this distinction decides the next test, treatment, or referral made.
steps.say: Stage the fibrosis, treat the heart risk; early NASH patients die cardiovascularly more than hepatically.

steps.tx: Seven to ten percent body weight loss resolves steatohepatitis in most adherent patients, exercise helping independently, while bariatric surgery and metabolic drugs serve selected advanced cases. That prescription is **weight loss therapy thresholds in NASH**. That is why this detail earns its place in every examination and ward round.
steps.say: Ten percent weight loss is NASH's most proven drug; prescribe it with the seriousness of one.

steps.tx: Alcohol abstinence after alcoholic hepatitis decides survival more powerfully than any drug, addiction services therefore joining hepatology from admission rather than discharge leaflets. That integration is **abstinence centred alcoholic liver care**. Remembering it prevents the commonest errors made with this presentation entirely.
steps.say: Abstinence is the only survival drug proven in alcoholic hepatitis; addiction care starts on day one.

steps.tx: Steatosis alone on imaging with normal enzymes still earns fibrosis risk scoring because silent advanced fibrosis hides in diabetes clinics, not liver units. That case finding is **fibrosis case finding in metabolic steatosis**. The clinical payoff comes from applying it early, before complications accumulate further.
steps.say: Normal enzymes never acquit fibrosis in diabetes; score or scan every steatotic liver's stiffness.
